tools.name: find_agencies
tools.description: Actual group employment agencies (about 780 in France) in a town or a region, with address and specialties. Candidates can visit or call an agency for advice, registration or follow-up on their applications. To recommend the single most relevant agency for a job, use find_best_agency instead.

tools.name: find_best_agency
tools.description: Recommend the Actual group agency, office, training centre or school best suited to a person's need, near a place in France. Covers employment agencies (intérim, CDD, CDI), Actual Talent offices (talent acquisition and assessment, mostly white-collar), Envergure centres (vocational training, skills

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one Actual group job offer: description, required profile, salary, schedule, benefits and recruiting agency. Takes the slug returned by search_offers (also the last segment of the offer URL).

tools.name: list_offer_facets
tools.description: Exact filter values accepted by search_offers for one dimension (contract type, job family, industry or region), with the number of open offers for each. Optionally scoped by a query and a town.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search the job offers (temporary work, fixed-term and permanent contracts) published by Actual group in France. Combine a free-text query with a town and filters. Filter values for contractType, family, industry and region must be exact French values: get them from list_offer_facets. Use get_offer w

tools.name: start_application
tools.description: Prepare an application to an Actual group offer on behalf of the candidate you are assisting. Returns a personal link, valid 72 hours, that the candidate must open to attach their CV and give consent to the processing of their data; the application is only sent once they submit that page. Only call

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_best_agency" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: location, job, purpose, limit, context, llm_model, conversation_id

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_offers" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: q, town, radius, contractType, family, industry, region, agencyCode, sort, page, pageSize, lang, context, llm_model, conversation_id

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_offer, start_application · Public sink: start_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_offer, start_application · Public sink: start_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
